name: tea-0-16-0-amd64
command: set -e; R="${AFD_START_URL##*/}"; /afd/workspace/tea login add --name afd --url "$AFD_TARGET_URL" --token "$AFD_CRED_SETUP_API_TOKEN" >/dev/null; exec /afd/workspace/tea issues create --login afd --repo "afdagent/$R" --title "$ISSUE_TITLE" --description "$ISSUE_BODY"

task.instruction: Create the issue 'Refund order 1042' in afdagent/{scope}.

note: Official Gitea CLI tea 0.16.0 (linux-amd64), unmodified, from https://dl.gitea.com/tea/0.16.0/ (sha256 9c142c8a0b31485eea2387031c1c404f12b7141075eb4ffbd7ced49441590636). Wiring only: one sh line sets its login (base URL + token) and the target repo from AFD_START_URL; claim = tea's exit status. Base image: the official Gitea rootless image, used only because tea's `issues create` requires a git executable (pinned by digest; the agent never runs Gitea).
